parameters.query:
-- Fetch last 7 days of confidence scores
SELECT 
  user_message,
  detected_action,
  confidence_score,
  user_feedback,
  actual_action,
  created_at
FROM ai_confidence_scores
WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY created_at DESC;

-- Fetch current prompt (version 1 or highest active version)
SELECT system_prompt, version
FROM prompt_versions
WHERE is_active = true
ORDER BY version DESC
LIMIT 1;
